# Synthetic xHCI TRB words for the D1 host test. Four little-endian 32-bit words per line:
# parameter low, parameter high, status, control. The sequence is our own minimal example:
# enable slot, address device slot 1, configure endpoint slot 1, then a successful transfer
# event for slot 1 endpoint 1 with an 8-byte payload.
00000000 00000000 00000000 00002409
00001000 00000000 00000000 01002c0b
00002000 00000000 00000000 0100300c
00000000 00000000 01000008 01018020
